id: \bAre you \PN? Someone was talking about you earlier. They seemed a bit upset about something.
en: \bAre you \PN? Someone was talking about you earlier. They seemed a bit upset about something.
it: \bSei \PN? Poco fa qualcuno parlava di te. Sembrava un po' arrabbiato per qualcosa.
\bBuona giornata.

id: \bYou're a Trainer right? I'm not supposed to let you pass, but if you can beat Sabrina I'll let it slide.
en: \bYou're a Trainer right? I'm not supposed to let you pass, but if you can beat Sabrina I'll let it slide.
it: \bSei un Allenatore, vero? Non dovrei lasciarti passare, ma se riesci a battere Sabrina chiuderò un occhio.

id: \bI'm sorry, but I can't let you pass. Gym Leader's orders.
en: \bI'm sorry, but I can't let you pass. Gym Leader's orders.
it: \bMi dispiace, ma non posso lasciarti passare. Ordini della Capopalestra.

id: \bSorry, you can't enter Cycle Road without a Bicycle.
en: \bSorry, you can't enter Cycle Road without a Bicycle.
it: \bMi spiace, non puoi entrare nella Pista Ciclabile senza una Bicicletta.
\bLa Pista Ciclabile è un percorso fantastico.

id: \bI'm sorry, but I can't let you pass. There seems to be an evil organization blocking the waterways. The police are trying their best to take care of it.
en: \bI'm sorry, but I can't let you pass. There seems to be an evil organization blocking the waterways. The police are trying their best to take care of it.
it: \bMi dispiace, ma non posso lasciarti passare. Sembra che un'organizzazione malvagia stia bloccando i corsi d'acqua. La polizia sta facendo del suo meglio per risolvere la cosa.
\bQuesto sentiero è attualmente in costruzione.

id: \bDown this path is the Battle Dome.
en: \bDown this path is the Battle Dome.
it: \bPercorrendo questo sentiero si arriva alla Cupola Lotta.

id: \bThis bridge is being repaired right now. Come back later.
en: \bThis bridge is being repaired right now. Come back later.
it: \bQuesto ponte è in riparazione. Torna più tardi.
\bSto cercando uno Slowbro.

id: \bWant to trade it for my Lickitung?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Lickitung?
it: \bVuoi scambiarlo con il mio Lickitung?
\bNon vuoi fare lo scambio?  Peccato...
\bOK, cominciamo.
Lickitung
Haden
\PN ha scambiato Slowbro con Lickitung!
\bGrazie!
\bNon vuoi scambiare? Uffa...
\bCome se la cava il mio Lickitung?

id: \rWe're going riding together on our new bikes. Yay!
en: \rWe're going riding together on our new bikes. Yay!
it: \rAndiamo a fare un giro insieme sulle nostre bici nuove. Evviva!

id: \rSince we now have bikes, I don't need this. Take it.
en: \rSince we now have bikes, I don't need this. Take it.
it: \rOra che abbiamo le bici, questo non mi serve più. Prendilo.

id: Are you enjoying flying as much as I enjoy riding my bike?
en: Are you enjoying flying as much as I enjoy riding my bike?
it: Ti diverti a volare quanto io mi diverto ad andare in bici?

id: \bHi! I heard from Professor Oak that you would be around here. He said to give you this.
en: \bHi! I heard from Professor Oak that you would be around here. He said to give you this.
it: \bCiao! Il Professor Oak mi ha detto che saresti passato da queste parti. Mi ha chiesto di darti questo.

id: \bAn Amulet Coin is an item to be held by a Pokémon. If the Pokémon appears in a winning battle, you will earn more money.
en: \bAn Amulet Coin is an item to be held by a Pokémon.  If the Pokémon appears in a winning battle, you will earn more money.
it: \bIl Monetamuleto è uno strumento da far tenere a un Pokémon.  Se il Pokémon partecipa a una lotta vinta, guadagnerai più soldi.

id: \rMy Pichu just learned this move so I guess I can teach it to you.
en: \rMy Pichu just learned this move so I guess I can teach it to you.
it: \rIl mio Pichu ha appena imparato questa mossa, quindi credo di poterla insegnare anche a te.
\rSi chiama Locomovolt.

id: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \rA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?
\rIo resto qui.

id: \bI'm on a relaxing ride on my new bike with my girlfriend.
en: \bI'm on a relaxing ride on my new bike with my girlfriend.
it: \bMi sto godendo un giro rilassante sulla mia bici nuova con la mia ragazza.
